_doc: Shadower skill definitions (spec #425). Empty until the skill tickets land; each appends inside its own region, and a key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). SH6 #431 moves Double Stab, Steal and Savage Blow here from skills/thief.json (ported, no explicit ranks); SH7 #432 Assaulter (mobility); SH8 #433 Boomerang Step and Band of Thieves; SH9 #434 Ninja Ambush (key ninja_ambush_shadower); SH10 #435 Meso Explosion; SH11 #436 Dark Sight (moved from skills/thief.json and rewritten as a hidden Form) and Assassinate (form_sub); SH12 #437 Smokescreen (safe_zone). The pool is in jobs/shadower.json.

assaulter.name: Assaulter
assaulter.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to dash that way, striking the first monster in your path and maybe stunning it. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Assaulter key with an arrow key to dash that way, striking the first monster in your path; it may be stunned. Bosses are hit but never stunned. Hold the key to keep dashing.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance to stun for {time} sec, dashes forward.

assaulter._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4211002 (book 421; rank 1 = WZ level 4 at Lv1, rank 8 = level 30 from Lv16 by the shared balance.mobility_rank_levels rule, the same rank as Hero's Rush at every level): damage 240 / 350 / 450 % at ranks 1 / 4 / 8, prop (the stun chance) 28 / 50 / 80 %, time (the stun seconds) 2 / 3 / 4, mobCount 1, the box lt (-200,-120) rb (0,0) at every level, whose reach is also the dash distance (field lt.x, 200 px), the assaulter action, the hit/0 art and the Use sound; the node has no effect. Tier C: the 2.0 s cooldown (the balance lever, Rush's), the stun replaces Rush's always-on knock-back (no knockback block), the first monster along the path (bosses first, then nearest to where the dash began, the charge's ordering), hold-to-repeat, no start while climbing, no meter gain or bonus, never a card (no rarity bonuses), the bot dashes away from a mob within 60 px at most every 3 s (BotInput.RUSH_MIN_INTERVAL), the 0.6 s action hold (the body's two 600 ms frames are not both played), the `mob` stun stars are the generic stun cue (the node is not wired). GAME_DESIGN 7.135 (SH7 #432).

boomerang_step.name: Boomerang Step
boomerang_step.desc: Throws a stab down the line in front of you and back again, stunning the monsters it catches.

text.desc: Stab the nearest monsters in the line in front of you twice each; each may be stunned. Needs a monster in the line.
text.h: Damage {damage}% x {attack_count}, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.

boomerang_step._rarity: Tier C: first-pass SH8 #433 bonuses (spec #425): Dagger Mastery and Dagger Booster are the 420 passives' names, Second Pass adds one monster to the line; Legendary shares the Unique's id (and its repeat counter) plus damage x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.135.
boomerang_step._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4221007 damage 290 to 500 % (rank 1 = level 4: 290 %), attackCount 2, mobCount 2 to 4, prop (stun chance 38 to 90 %), time (stun seconds 2 to 4), the forward box lt (-300,-110) rb (0,0), the alert5 action, effect (15 frames), hit/0 (hit/1 is identical), the Use and Hit sounds; the stray masterLevel 10 is ignored. Tier C: the 3.0 s cooldown, min_targets 1, the 0.6 s action hold (the body's three 300 ms frames are not all played), the default 30-level rank table, no weapon gate, the stun stars are the generic cue (the `mob` node is not wired). GAME_DESIGN 7.135.

band_of_thieves.name: Band of Thieves
band_of_thieves.desc: Calls your other selves out of the shadows; each one strikes every monster around you.

text.desc: Your other selves strike the nearest monsters around you, one line each. Needs a monster in the band's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}% x {attack_count} (one per other self), up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}.

band_of_thieves._rarity: Tier C: first-pass SH8 #433 bonuses (spec #425): Band Mastery, Wide Band and Bigger Band are flavour names; Bigger Band adds one more thief (a line on every struck monster); Legendary shares the Unique's id (and its repeat counter) plus damage x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.135.
band_of_thieves._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4211004 damage 110 to 210 % per line (rank 1 = level 4: 140 %; it DROPS at levels 7, 13, 19 and 25 where `x` steps up, the totals never fall), x 1 to 5 ("N other selves will attack"), mobCount 2 to 6, the symmetric box +-130 to +-150 by +-50, the effect (5 frames) and hit/0..5 art (hit/1..5 are the thief figures, 5 of the 6 nodes carry hitAfter), the Use sound; the node has no action. Tier C: `attack_count_field x` (each other self lands one line on every struck monster, SH-8), the 8.0 s cooldown, min_targets 1, action `weapon` (the held dagger's first stance, the swingO1 fallback of the asset notes) held 0.6 s, hit/1..5 by line (hit/0, the common strike, is the fallback), hitAfter is not modelled (every line lands on the cast tick), no weapon gate, no status. GAME_DESIGN 7.135.

double_stab.name: Double Stab
double_stab.desc: Stabs one monster twice within your dagger's reach.
double_stab._tier: Tier A: WZ weapon 33, damage, attackCount 2, mpCon, stabO1 action and CharLevel hit art. Tier C: weapon_reach auto-cast, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 0.6s; untuned. SH6 #431 (GAME_DESIGN 7.135): ported from thief.json with the default rank table (no explicit `ranks`: 20 levels, ranks 1..8 read levels 3 / 5 / 8 / 10 / 13 / 15 / 18 / 20), same numbers, cast rule, 1.2 s cooldown, art and sounds; rarity bonuses (tier C, spec #425). Untuned.

steal.name: Steal
steal.desc: A melee strike that can take one extra item from each monster, including bosses.
steal._tier: Tier A: canonical damage, mpCon, prop, swingO2 action, effect and sound; no weapon gate. Owner #167: retry until success, one extra loot per logical mob, bosses included. Tier C: range_around auto-cast within 100px, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 0.6s; extra loot uses ordinary equipment chance/pool, else a normal meso bundle; untuned. SH6 #431 (GAME_DESIGN 7.135): ported from thief.json with the default rank table (no explicit `ranks`: 30 levels, ranks 1..8 read levels 4 / 8 / 12 / 15 / 19 / 23 / 27 / 30), same numbers, cast rule, 1.2 s cooldown, art and sounds; rarity bonuses (tier C, spec #425). Untuned.

text.desc: Strikes nearby monsters and tries to take an extra item. Each monster, including a boss, can be stolen from once; failed attempts can be retried.
text.h: {damage}% damage, {prop}% chance to steal one extra item.

savage_blow.name: Savage Blow
savage_blow.desc: Strikes a monster up to six times with a dagger.
savage_blow._tier: Tier A: canonical weapon 33, attackCount, damage, mpCon, savage action, effect, hit art and sounds. Tier C: weapon_reach auto-cast, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 1.0s; untuned. SH6 #431 (GAME_DESIGN 7.135): ported from thief.json with the default rank table (no explicit `ranks`: 30 levels, ranks 1..8 read levels 4 / 8 / 12 / 15 / 19 / 23 / 27 / 30), same numbers, cast rule, 1.2 s cooldown, art and sounds; rarity bonuses (tier C, spec #425). Untuned.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.desc: Sets off a smoke cloud at your feet; hits that land while you stand inside it are negated.

text.desc: Throw down a smoke shell: for a few seconds every hit that lands on you while you stand inside the cloud is negated. The cloud stays where it was set off. Needs three monsters close by.

smokescreen._rarity: Tier C: first-pass SH12 #437 bonuses (spec #425): Wide Smoke and Thick Smoke are flavour names and Haste is the 420 passive's; Wide Smoke widens the box (`area`, the cloud has no damage), Haste shortens the cooldown, Thick Smoke lengthens the cloud (`zone_time`, a 9 s cloud); Legendary shares the Unique's id (and its repeat counter) plus `area` x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8, and Normal Mastery on this `damage: none` skill is cooldown x0.95 (#346). GAME_DESIGN 7.136.
smokescreen._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4221006 (30 levels; rank 1 = level 4) lt / rb box +-120 x +-90 at rank 1, (-150,-112)..(150,113) at rank 4 and +-200 x +-150 at rank 8, read as given (the y edges are not symmetric at some levels), the smokeshell action, the 11-frame `effect` (the cast: a dust ring and the green shell) and the `tile` (eleven two-frame puffs, each fading in and out) as the cloud, the Use sound. Tier C: the 6.0 s life (WZ `time` 34 to 60 s is session scale and is not read), the 24 s cooldown (WZ `cooltime` 600 is a session value and is not read), admission at three monsters within 250 px, the 0.6 s action hold, the default 30-level rank table, the cloud's look (SafeZoneView). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.136.

ninja_ambush_shadower.name: Ninja Ambush
ninja_ambush_shadower.desc: Hides ninjas where you stand; they strike the monsters in the zone every second.

text.desc: Leave an ambush at your feet. Its ninjas strike up to 6 monsters in the zone every second. Needs a monster in the zone's box.
text.h: Damage {damage}% per strike, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, for {time} sec.

ninja_ambush_shadower._rarity: Tier C: first-pass SH9 #434 bonuses (spec #425): Shadow Shifter (the lineage passive 4220002) and Wide Ambush; Ambush Squad adds two monsters to every strike (`count` raises mobCount); Legendary shares the Unique's id plus damage x1.2; Mastery repeats shrink x0.8. GAME_DESIGN 7.135 (SH9).
ninja_ambush_shadower._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 4221004 equals 4121004 in every field of all 30 levels (SH1 scan, re-checked by test_shadower_ninja_ambush): damage 62 to 100 % per strike (rank 1 = level 4: 68 %), mobCount 6, time 4 / 8 / 12 s, the symmetric box +-110 -> +-200 by (-130, 70) (rank 1 +-120), the alert3 action, the 19-frame effect, the mob0 strike art on each struck monster; the Use sound is a UOL into 4121004. Tier C (a data copy of Night Lord's, spec SH-16): the 14 s cooldown, min_targets 1, `ground.strike` {interval 1.0, first_delay 0.3} anchored at the cast, the 0.6 s action hold, no tile art, the default 30-level rank table, no weapon gate; Shadow Shifter level 5 (the WZ req) is ignored. GAME_DESIGN 7.135 (SH9).

_sh9_region: SH9 #434: ninja_ambush_shadower is the last key of the SH9 region (a data copy of Night Lord's ninja_ambush, owner data and Shadower bonuses only).
